entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Hi Sarah... I hope you can help me. I need to make a return. I bought a helmet a few weeks ago, and I just... I can't keep it. I've been a loyal customer for a while and I really needed this money for something else that's come up.
I'm sorry to hear that you're in a tough spot. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Of course. The name is David Miller, and the order number is VF654321.

Thank you, David. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero Helmet, delivered 21 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference matter?

Oh no, there's nothing wrong with it. The box is still completely unopened. The color just wasn't quite what I expected, and like I said, I feel guilty about the purchase now. Things are just a bit tight.
I completely understand, and I appreciate you clarifying that for me. Let me just review the return policy for this item... One moment.

Okay, David, I have good news. According to our policy, standard items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process this for you right away.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried.

It's my pleasure to help. Your peace of mind is just as important as your safety on the road. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to you. All you need to do is attach it to the original shipping box with the unopened helmet inside and drop it off at the post office.
That's wonderful. You've really helped me out today. Thank you.
You are very welcome, David. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
